entities.name: Elixir Mechanics
entities.summary: The deep rules of Genome powers, worked out jointly by Ryan and Dr. Tyrano. Elixirs are alive, virus-like alien intelligences that carry information by unknown means (not RNA/DNA) yet manipulate human DNA: on use, an Alchemist Elixir bonds to a homo sapiens' cells and rewrites their genes to make them the vessel of a unique power, ignoring animals. The Elixir acts as an intermediary between host and the color-dimension that supplies the power, and subtly guides its host (or, in Psychos, pushes them to consume ever more Elixirs). No two powers are identical (only variants), implying the Elixir draws each ability from a collective database and locks it from new hosts; a divided dose still bonds to only one person. A host tolerates at most TWO powers: additional Elixirs edit the same genes and conflict ('two writers fighting over a script'), so the original pair cannibalizes newcomers, briefly repurposing them to stabilize the code before conflict resumes. Rare individuals (Augustus, Livia) hold two powers without side-effects via specific genes or non-overlapping edits. A White Elixir (Mongrel's) acts as a 'referee' forcing extra Elixirs to coexist, granting more than two powers but not sparing the host from conflict, mutation, or addiction.

Deadpan-jealous, it forbids 'Elixir bigamy,' and sends him off with 'Onward.'

plotlines.title: Mechron's Last Stand
plotlines.summary: Flashback: at the final battle of Sarajevo, Leo Hargraves rallies 500+ Genomes of the Anti-Mechron Front, networked by Pythia, and drops Mechron's forcefield with a supernova beam. Amid the machine war Mechron launches his twin orbital weapons; the Cossack downs the Kujata but a Mechron-made gravity-controlling Red dragon delays Leo and the Bahamut escapes to orbit. Pythia redirects Leo to the fortress, warning something worse than the satellite waits inside: 'It's all black.'

plotlines.title: The Darkness Beyond
plotlines.summary: Inside the fortress-collider Leo confronts a broken, hateful Mechron, who refuses surrender and opens a gate meant for the Blue World / Akashic Records. It instead breaches onto the Darkness Beyond, an eye-like void entity that erases Mechron atom by atom and begins consuming reality. Leo collapses the fortress by going supernova, sealing the gate at the cost of near-death. He wakes days later: the war is won, but Pythia is brain-damaged, the Bahamut lost, and her USB names Bloodstream as humanity's top threat.

plotlines.title: Progress Made
plotlines.summary: Back in the present, Ryan cleans up the party wreck and learns Jamie proposed to Ki-jung and will reinvest his new Mercury division into Rust Town charity. Over the Chronoradio, Len (warming toward him, hinting he could visit the orphans) proposes the consciousness-transfer plan to let someone else remember across loops, but it needs Mechron's bunker tech. Ryan refuses to give the Augusti bunker access and accepts this good loop still won't be perfect.

plotlines.title: The Ghost of Drug Island
plotlines.summary: Laying low on Vulcan's orders, Ryan spends the weekend with Jasmine designing his power armor and a scheme to trap his own 'Violet Flux' to boost his power. She reveals Dynamis's decade-long mind-uploading immortality project (brain scans into Tyrano's cloned bodies), and Ryan realizes combining it with Len's and Jasmine's tech could let him carry a companion across loops, giving him hope. They fly to the miasma-choked Ischia superlab for Livia's defense inspection, where Livia introduces the ghost Geist as a sentry and warns that many alternate realities now end in her own sudden death. Ryan, planning to blow up the island to settle his debt with Shroud, sizes up how to bring the fortress down.

plotlines.title: Return of the Corpo
plotlines.summary: Locked out of the Ischia facility's secrets, Ryan passes the inspection playing knucklebones with Geist and Mortimer, learning Geist's origin, that Ceres is the sole Bliss cook, and that Bliss sterilizes ordinary users. Len calls with alarm, tremors from Rust Town and flying objects inbound on Ischia, then Blackthorn calls to gloat: as retaliation for the HQ raid, Don Hector has finally chosen war. Thirty Dynamis war helicopters and Il Migliore's elite (Wyvern, Windsweep, Devilry) descend on the island, demanding Quicksave and Jasmine surrender. Vulcan refuses, Wyvern transforms into a dragon, and the drug-lab battle erupts, exactly the destruction Ryan owes Shroud, so he sits back to watch.

plotlines.title: Blood in the Water
plotlines.summary: The Ischia battle erupts into chaos: Geist swats helicopters, Vulcan grapples the dragon-form Wyvern out to sea, and Ryan duels the newly-arrived Il Migliore pair, Reload and Wardrobe. He steals Reload's violet lightsaber and toys with the self-resurrecting hero, but Wardrobe's shifting costumes escalate until her unstable 'Augustus' guise blasts Ryan with imitation lightning that reaches him even inside stopped time, the exact threat Chitter once warned him about. As she readies a deadly 'Apocalypse Suit,' Len arrives in her underwater armor with skyscraper-sized water arms (mistaken for Neptune) and Augusti reinforcements race in on jet skis. Before Wardrobe can transform, Mortimer phases up and shoots her dead, winning his kill-count bet.

plotlines.title: While Rome Burns
plotlines.summary: Ryan reaches the Junkyard, blaming himself for leaving Mechron's bunker for the Meta to seize. He finds the five surviving Psychos (Adam, Frank, Acid Rain, Sarin, and the dirt-formed Land) holding a rock concert beneath the risen orbital-control tower as New Rome burns. Adam gloats that he tracked the sabotage back to Ryan/'Cesare,' reveals he is dying as his Elixir-abused powers go haywire, and that, denied a cure by Psyshock's death, he fired the Bahamut out of pure Jonestown spite, then threatens Len's underwater orphanage. Ryan attacks, unleashing the plushie on Acid Rain, blinding Adam, and killing the Land and Sarin, but is caught between Adam's chain and the Land and nearly force-fed an Elixir, until Vulcan, Lanka and Jamie crash in to rescue him.

plotlines.title: Bad End
plotlines.summary: Vulcan (temporarily allied with Wyvern), Jamie and Lanka fight the Meta until Augustus himself descends, moving through Ryan's stopped time. The invulnerable emperor kills Frank, savagely beats and captures Adam (to be crucified alive for killing his family), then destroys Mechron's bunker with a thunderbolt, obliterating the orbital tech, the Chronoradio plans' hardware, and Ryan's last hope of the consciousness-transfer plan. Ryan wakes in a Sorrento hospital to the loop's ruin: Len is dead, his car and the Chronoradio destroyed, and with Hector and Enrique gone the hardliner Alphonse now steers Dynamis toward a new war. Only the cat Schrodinger survived. Deciding he must finally change and stop relying on Len alone, Ryan chooses to trust Vulcan and reveals his secret: 'I can time-travel.'

plotlines.title: Time and Again
plotlines.summary: In Vulcan's makeshift lab, Jasmine seals Ryan into the purple power armor for a desperate gambit: using it to open a physical rift to the Purple World so she can time-travel with him rather than be erased by the reset. They share a last kiss and pop-culture banter, and she makes him promise never to replace her or forget her. Ryan activates his power; violet particles multiply uncontrollably and pull him bodily into the Purple World, where he witnesses a vision of the homo-novus founders and their crashed craft, the color-dimension cosmology, a plushie meadow, and a planet-sized god-entity. Then the loop resets to May 8, 2020, in his restored car. Jasmine didn't make it through, but a haunting recording of his rooftop talk with Len plays over the Chronoradio. Ryan vows to keep his promise and complete the Perfect Run.

plotlines.title: Past Fragment: How to Tame Your Plushie
plotlines.summary: A flashback to an earlier loop reveals the plushie's origin. A younger Ryan, learning Genius tech from his cyborg roommate Alchemo ('Braindead'), builds a cute rabbit plushie as a probe to send through a mini particle accelerator into the Purple World, hoping to enable his car's dimensional time-travel. The accelerator runs in reverse, frying the hardware and anchoring an alien tentacled entity inside the toy. The possessed plushie kills Alchemo on sight (repeatedly), spares the gynoid Doll/Tea and children, strings up human victims, and multiplies exponentially when happy, overrunning Firenze in one loop. Ryan resets each time and finally tames it by flipping its switch off on reload, keeping it as a last-resort weapon he dares not destroy lest he free what lives inside. It watches over his sleep, pledging eternal friendship.

plotlines.title: Route Split
plotlines.summary: A new loop resets everyone's memories, wiping Ryan's progress with Jasmine (Vulcan doesn't remember him). Choosing to avoid an Augusti run so soon after losing her, Ryan takes the Dynamis path instead: he pitches Wyvern to join Il Migliore and warns Shroud that Adam is after the orbital Bahamut. Shroud, shaken that Ryan knows the secret name, believes him and postpones the Carnival's Augusti strikes to prioritize the bunker crisis, urging Ryan to infiltrate Dynamis and report back. Ryan then notices his cat Schrodinger has gained a teleport power from Violet-dimension exposure. Finally Len, who overheard the time-travel recording, radios him live: she now knows he can time-travel, and asks why he didn't just re-run their reconciliation. Ryan explains he wants their bond to be true, not manufactured, and heads to the orphanage where Len agrees to meet him.

plotlines.title: Chance Meetings
plotlines.summary: Ryan meets Enrique 'Blackthorn' Manada and lays out his evidence that a Dynamis insider armed the Meta-Gang. Enrique proves clean: he fires the negligent drone-handler, deduces a board-level traitor may be the sponsor, and takes the unstable-but-useful Ryan into Il Migliore's junior division on a six-month supervised trial, granting Ryan's terms (keep his name, never touch the Underdiver). Ryan adopts the hapless hero-hopeful Timmy 'the Panda' as his sidekick, naming their team 'Quicksave the Pandas.' Driving home he learns Dynamis surveils Len's undersea base (likely how Adam found it) and resolves to get her real antidepressant treatment. On Sol Street a chance encounter throws him together with the haughty Fortuna and the intrigued Livia Augusti, whose Purple-World sight cannot perceive Ryan or clearly see his teleporting cat Schrodinger. Ryan rebuffs Fortuna's demand for a ride and drives off, leaving Livia watching him with curiosity.

plotlines.title: Fashion Disaster
plotlines.summary: At Wardrobe's Il Migliore atelier, Yukiko designs Ryan's signature costume (dark-purple cashmere suit, clock-symbol scarf, silver-and-black mask) and 'Rambo Panda' for Timmy, while the practical Atom Cat resists a latex cat-suit. Ryan rallies Wardrobe, the Panda, and Atom Cat into an unsanctioned Rust Town patrol to test the costumes. En route Wardrobe explains her power copies the collective *idea* of a persona (not real abilities), that she can become the persona if worn too long, and that her 'Apocalypse Suit' could destroy the world, but she cannot copy the obscure Cancel, spoiling Ryan's plan against Psyshock. Atom Cat is revealed as Livia Augusti's brother and ex who broke with his family. Fortuna, obsessed after Ryan's rejection, spams him with 41 messages. Then a cryptic 'Unknown' texts 'The orange is in the hen house'; Ryan slams the brakes and replies as 'PlushieTamer,' racing back toward the orphanage.

plotlines.title: A Gambling Man
plotlines.summary: Ryan brings his patrol team (Wardrobe, Atom Cat, the Panda) plus Len to defend the Rust Town orphanage from Psyshock's raid. Rattled that someone sent him his private power-catchphrase ('the orange is in the hen house'), Ryan suspects Livia may retain loop memories. When Psyshock arrives with reinforcements (Rakshasa and a lizard-man), Ryan runs an audacious poker bluff, posing as Hector Manada's envoy, and extracts the full conspiracy: the Meta approached Don Hector for a knockoff supply, never intended to hit the Augusti, are secretly unearthing Mechron's bunker, and Psyshock's 'second project' is a mind-transfer brain-scan (workable only between closely related brains). Shroud records it all invisibly. His trap sprung, Ryan sucker-punches Psyshock as every window in the area shatters, launching the ambush.

plotlines.title: The Future Past
plotlines.summary: The orphanage ambush becomes a crushing victory: Shroud, Len, Wardrobe (in a Che Guevara costume), Atom Cat, and a surprisingly formidable Panda subdue the Meta mooks into Len's suspended-animation bubbles, and Rakshasa's cross-universe gremlins flee in terror on recognizing Ryan. But Psyshock again suicides to escape capture. Ryan plays the wiretapped confession for his team, turning Atom Cat and a murderous Len against Dynamis, and they agree to hand the recording to Enrique for a by-the-book arrest. Then Ryan and Len drive to the ominous Deadland Motel answering the 'Unknown' invitation, guarded by Cancel and Mortimer. Inside waits Livia Augusti, who reveals she remembers the loops too: his catchphrase was a 'message in a bottle' that reached her, and she invites Ryan to compare their memories.

plotlines.title: Heartfelt Talk
plotlines.summary: At Deadland Motel, Ryan and Livia trade their full truths in a tense, chess-framed parley. Livia demands honesty and threatens to expose Ryan to her father unless he proves no threat to her family; Ryan counters by exposing Bliss as Augustus's deliberate sterility weapon, cracking Livia's regal mask to reveal a daughter crushed by trying to protect a family she cannot reform. They strike a fragile mutual-honesty truce. Ryan explains his time-loop; Livia admits her two powers (Blue-Elixir six-screen alternate-sight archived in a 'blue room,' plus a localized temporal anomaly) and the genetic quirk she shares with Augustus. They test their powers against each other over the chessboard: Ryan acts as an untouchable 'ghost' inside her anomaly and freezes her (she, unlike Augustus, is not immune), confirming Ryan's higher-dimension theory that he is 'the controller' whose Purple power sustains or collapses her simulated timelines. Ryan withholds Shroud/the Carnival and Mechron's bunker; the talk breaks down over mutual mistrust, ending with dueling protect-lists and Livia's promise to call again. Driving home, Ryan tells Len he confided in Livia because he's 'seen it before' and it ended badly.

plotlines.title: The Island of Dr. Tyrano
plotlines.summary: Ryan settles into a bribe-lavish Dynamis penthouse and reunites with his Menagerie teammates, now media darlings after the arrests. He gifts Wardrobe a homemade Playboy-bunny costume (a cultural kinship cemented), and probes Atom Cat for intel: Augustus's invulnerability secret is guarded by the spymaster Mercury, and Felix reports the patriarch has grown lethargic and forgetful, hiding a sick face behind an electric halo, hinting something is deeply wrong with him. Meeting Dr. Tyrano, the T-rex-transformed Blue Genius who makes knockoff Elixirs and creates dinosaur hybrids, Ryan rescues the Panda from vivisection and discovers a kindred theorist: the two lay out the full Elixir cosmology (living virus-like Elixirs, color-dimension power sources, the two-power limit and its conflicts, Mongrel's referee White Elixir). Ryan angles for access to Tyrano's brain-copy project (Level-5 clearance required) and Mechron's bunker as a possible cure for his own power's degeneration.

plotlines.title: Family Business
plotlines.summary: Between Dynamis film-studio nonsense (screenwriters wanting to rewrite the Panda as an uplifted mascot), Ryan and Felix take a coffee break and open up. Ryan reveals he knows Felix is the son of Mars and Venus; Felix explains he abandoned the Augusti over Bliss, recounting how his friend Chitter nearly died of a Bliss overdose and begged for more, how Narcinia is guilt-tripped into making the drug, and how Ki-jung was drawn into the Killer Seven. Ryan admits he arranged Bloodstream's death and commiserates over toxic families. Fortuna crashes the studio (via her luck power) to drag Felix home, and the siblings quarrel bitterly over the Killer Seven and the family. Then Ryan gets a call from Leonard Hargraves, the Carnival's leader who killed Felix and Livia's mother: his team has arrived in New Rome, and he invites Ryan and Atom Cat to ally against the city's 'cancers.' Ryan accepts.

plotlines.title: Corpoalition
plotlines.summary: Ryan drives Felix (shielded from Dynamis's Flux tracker) to a Carnival war council at the Pompei ruins, where Leo Hargraves, Shroud, and Ace reveal a grand alliance is forming against the Meta and the Augusti. Enrique 'Blackthorn' and Wyvern arrive (Enrique secretly contacted the Carnival), then Dynamis VP Alphonse 'Fallout' Manada, the exiled nuke-Genome 'butcher of Malta,' descends by helicopter. The corroborated wiretap convinces the corpos of Don Hector's treachery. They agree a coordinated strike: the Carnival beheads the Meta's leadership (Psyshock, who mind-jumps and uses hostages) while Dynamis's force surrounds and contains Adam's men in Rust Town, without telling the corpos about Mechron's bunker. Alphonse further commits to a coup deposing their father Don Hector, dismaying Wyvern who dreads him as CEO. Leo pulls Felix aside about Narcinia. Finally Enrique lets slip the secret that reframes everything: Augustus is dying of a brain tumor, and Hector is simply waiting it out. Ryan freezes at the revelation.

The corroborated wiretap convinces the corpos of Don Hector's treachery. They agree a coordinated strike: the Carnival beheads the Meta's leadership (Psyshock, who mind-jumps and uses hostages) while Dynamis's force surrounds and contains Adam's men in Rust Town, without telling the corpos about Mechron's bunker. Alphonse further commits to a coup deposing their father Don Hector, dismaying Wyvern who dreads him as CEO. Leo pulls Felix aside about Narcinia. Finally Enrique lets slip the secret that reframes everything: Augustus is dying of a brain tumor, and Hector is simply waiting it out. Ryan freezes at the revelation.

plotlines.title: Lucky Break
plotlines.summary: After the war council, Ryan consoles a devastated Felix (who learned Augustus murdered Narcinia's parents), then calls Len: he suspects the Manada are after her over Dynamis's own buried secrets, and proposes she slip into the Meta's sea-access bunker during tomorrow's siege to steal the brain-duplicating tech (which Hector lent Psyshock). Len agrees and invites Ryan to move into a room she set up in her undersea base, sounding steadier as she paces her treatment. Ryan then keeps a smokescreen date with Fortuna at Le Parisien, intending to be so perfectly affectionate she loses interest, but Fortuna brings Livia along. Fortuna reveals hidden depth (secret sculptor, insecure about her face-shaping mother Venus, joined the Killer Seven to shield Livia), raising Ryan's esteem. Livia engineers a private moment to confront Ryan: she blames the Carnival for her mother Juno's death and warns him off her family and Fortuna. Ryan counters with hard truths, Augustus's brain tumor and that Narcinia's father could have cut it out, explaining Livia's paralysis before her invincible, ailing father; she leaves shaken. Ryan's plan backfires: Fortuna 'forgives' him and uses her busted luck to lock him in the car.

plotlines.title: Death Warrant
plotlines.summary: May 12th: Team Quicksave (Ryan, Atom Cat, the Panda, Wardrobe) drives to Rust Town for the coordinated raid, Wardrobe deducing (via a Sherlock costume) Ryan's chaste Fortuna date. Felix briefs them on the Meta leadership: Adam the Ogre (Brooklyn Cannibal, carbon-skin + pocket-stomach) and Frank the Mad (schizophrenic metal giant), while Ryan privately advances his Augustus theory (Frank's power proving Augustus registers as metal). Leo Hargraves strikes the Junkyard like a missile as Alphonse's helicopters swarm from the west; the Meta answer with missiles, a Frank-caused earthquake, and Sarin's acid clouds. Ryan's team battles Sarin (beheaded by Shroud) and the teleporting Acid Rain, who raves about 'the Ultimate One'/Purple World and calls Ryan a thief. The fight goes badly: Acid Rain blows off Shroud's arm, stabs Felix, and eviscerates the Panda (who heals by shapeshifting). Ryan out-skills her, but she readies a grenade begging to be 'sent there', until Mortimer, an Augusti assassin, snipes her dead. He refuses to fight Ryan, revealing Livia sent him: 'Miss Livia sends her regards.'

plotlines.title: Quest Complete
plotlines.summary: In the field shelter, Dr. Stitch (Carnival medic) and Wardrobe barely save the maimed Shroud with engineered bacteria. Ace portals Ryan and the Panda into Mechron's bunker, where Fallout and Dynamis security fight door-to-door through Psyshock's suicide-bomber thralls and human shields. Blackthorn (fighting personally, vine-mapping the halls) locates Adam and Psyshock at the brain-database command center. Cornered, Adam smashes a Mechron-made Black Elixir, which acts even in stopped time and, unable to assimilate him, devours him alive, its alien voice begging Ryan to 'open the gate' and 'send me to the Black' while canceling Fallout's nuclear ray, before dissolving Adam to nothing. Fallout then out-blasts the forcefield and vaporizes the brain-database; Blackthorn's poison-rose squid gasses Psyshock unconscious with aconitine, disabling his death-triggered mind-transfer. Ryan freezes time to disarm suicide belts and spare thralls, saving many but not all. The Meta-Gang is destroyed. Leo admits he knew of the bunker; the group heads to the Manada manor to arrest Don Hector. Len radios: safe under the sea, she has the braintech.

plotlines.title: End of Disc One
plotlines.summary: At Don Hector's modest manor, the Manada brothers and Leo Hargraves confront the CEO, found gardening. Enrique bluffs that Psyshock confessed everything (the Meta deal, the mind-transfer clone project), and Hector's flicker of surprise confirms he never knew about the Mechron base. Abandoned by his own guards and outgunned by his sons' shares, proof, and army, Hector surrenders with grim dignity rather than die pointlessly, choosing forced retirement; Alphonse and Enrique will reform Dynamis and finally move on Augustus. Ryan is fired from Il Migliore but spared; Enrique privately warns him to flee New Rome with Len before the ruthless Alphonse (who knows Len's base) hunts them, since Dynamis fixates on Len for reasons Enrique won't name. Livia calls, worried for Felix, offers Ryan the Killer Seven's Violet slot (declined), and grieves that her own father won't step down like Hector. Reunited with Len and the braintech, Ryan pieces the horror together: the knockoff Elixirs (a synth resource mimicking Elixirs, only ~3 years old), Dynamis's theft of Len's blood/DNA, and Enrique fleeing Lab Sixty-Six all point to a surviving clone of Bloodstream. Len, refusing to flee, insists they investigate Lab Sixty-Six for closure.

plotlines.title: A Death in Monaco
plotlines.summary: A past fragment revealing Ryan's defining death. Years after Bloodstream's death, a lonely Ryan scours the Mediterranean for the vanished Len and finally enters Monaco, the microstate 'nobody returns from.' He is teleported into the Monte Carlo Casino, a pocket dimension that suppresses his time-stop (but not his save point) and is patrolled by cannibalistic croupier-clowns who worship an unseen 'Prince Jean-Stéphanie.' The old French sheriff Simon rescues him and teaches him to survive among Suitestown's ~40 trapped powerless, along with Camus's philosophy of embracing the absurd ('the boulder is your only friend'). Ryan spends nearly a century there as the community dwindles, digs Simon's endless tunnel after the old man dies on a suicide run, and finally, as the last man alive, dies of OLD AGE in bed. His save point revives him young at the promontory: he realizes even old age can't kill him, that he is truly immortal. After hysterical laughter, horror gives way to liberation; he embraces the absurd, vowing to live fearlessly to the fullest, treating life as an endless game whose first quest is to free everyone trapped in Monaco.

plotlines.title: In Mysterious Ways
plotlines.summary: At the Ark (his 'Commie-Cave'), Ryan reconnects with Len as she works on the brain-transfer project, sharing a rare warm, tender moment (she chuckles at his jokes; they touch on their long-past romance). They diagnose the project's roadblock: transmitting a brainmap back through time needs Violet Flux power (Chronoradio hooked to Vulcan's armor), which reopens the mystery of who sent the ORIGINAL Chronoradio messages. Ryan proposes a 'blood beacon': Bloodstream may have left a trace inside Len that Dynamis now tracks, and Len's blood could match the Knockoff Elixirs to her father, hinting at a surviving clone. Studying Eugène-Henry's too-convenient teleports, Ryan concludes a benevolent guiding entity (the Alchemist / Purple-World pyramid) is steering them, and they consider seeking its Antarctic base. Ryan then heads to a Dynamis hospital for the heist plan, glimpsing an upset Narcinia leaving with Mortimer, and meets Wardrobe's Genius girlfriend Nora Moore ('the Architect'), who designed the Dynamis HQ and Optimates Tower, priceless intel for Ryan's scheme. He comforts the newly meme-famous, tearful Panda before being summoned to see Mr. Veran.

plotlines.title: The Hit
plotlines.summary: At Felix's hospital room, Nora feeds Ryan intel on Lab Sixty-Six's defenses (missile-proof, one elevator/blast-door entry, no emergency exit, 'secure not safe'), narrowing his infiltration options. Felix announces he's quitting Il Migliore for the Carnival and, wary that Ryan seems tied to Livia, confronts him, revealing he never loved Livia (their match was arranged since childhood) and that he told Narcinia the truth: Augustus murdered her birth parents and arranged her adoption to exploit her drug-making power, with Bacchus shattering her memory. The Il Migliore members are summoned to a war-council meeting (Ryan barred), confirming the Dynamis-Carnival strike on the Augusti is imminent. Livia calls in a panic: Augustus, now marshaling for war, has sent Aunt Pluto ('Cruella') to kill Felix, her death-curse already marks him and Ryan. Rather than abandon a teammate, Ryan guilts the resigned Felix into fleeing and arranges for Len to bathysphere them out to France, urging her to rebuild Vulcan's armor fast. The storm Enrique foretold breaks: war has come to New Rome, and they escape in the Pandamobile.

plotlines.title: Murphy's Law
plotlines.summary: Ryan and Felix flee New Rome in the fur-covered Pandamobile toward a rendezvous with Len near the Amalfi Coast. Fortuna calls, her luck power inexplicably connecting her to Ryan instead of Felix. The Augusti catch up: Aunt Pluto in a bulletproof Lamborghini, escorted by Killer Seven assassins the Vamp (pheromone/touch-kill) and Night Terror (Blue Genome whose darkness power conjures illusions). A running highway chase ensues, Pluto's death-curse escalating from failing brakes to collapsing highway pillars as she closes in, while Felix hurls explosive darts. Ryan works out he can resist her causality warp by selectively stopping time. He jumps the Pandamobile across a collapsed section, but after nightfall Night Terror unleashes an illusion of Ryan's dead father Bloodstream ('Cesare') choking him, making him crash off the highway. Ryan's time-stop instinct saves both from the exploding wreck, and the pair escape into the dark woods as Pluto and the Vamp give chase, the hunt only beginning.

plotlines.title: Death Stranding
plotlines.summary: In the Valle Delle Ferriere woods, Ryan splits off from Felix to draw the single-target Pluto onto himself. He confronts the Vamp (Karen Ricci), resisting her seductive pheromones via drug tolerance, and Night Terror (Richard Pinkman), who conjures Monaco clowns and a horrifying blood-drenched Len taunting that Ryan never escaped Monaco. Ryan kills both at a waterfall. Pluto arrives and, studying his marker, realizes it links to a second universe her curse can't reach, she can kill him but never permanently. She unleashes her full curse: reality itself turns lethal (noose-branches, self-moving knife, exploding gun, his own primed A-bomb), collapsing the ground and burying Ryan in rubble. As she moves to execute him, Felix returns and is impaled by defensive spears; Pluto reveals their own parents authorized the hit. Eugène-Henry then appears, and Fortuna arrives, her luck flickering yellow energy that neutralizes Pluto's curse and shields Felix. Learning the truth, Fortuna turns traitor, aiming her gun at her godmother to defend her brother, and the chapter ends on two gunshots.

plotlines.title: Limited Time
plotlines.summary: Fortuna's lucky headshot kills Pluto and ends the curse, but she dies of her own wound in Felix's arms; a crippled, dying Ryan is rescued by Len in her diving armor. The Purple World entity in Eugène-Henry bids Ryan 'the rest is up to you' and departs in violet light, leaving a normal cat. Ryan wakes days later in Len's underwater base, legless and bandaged, tended by Little Sarah, with a catatonic Felix nearby (his own parents signed his death warrant, his sister died for him). Len shows him New Rome consumed by all-out war, Augusti vs Dynamis/Carnival, Mars, Neptune, Wyvern, Wardrobe's Cthulhu 'apocalypse suit,' and Augustus dueling Enrique atop Mount Augustus, another bad ending, spread across the whole coast. Livia calls via Vulcan's line, now fully allied through grief and guilt: she offers to back up a snapshot of Len's memory-map (kept via her journal) so the loop's progress can survive if the risky consciousness-transfer fails. Len, overcoming her distrust, agrees and reveals the transfer will kill Ryan to send her memories back. Ryan realizes Eugène-Henry's entity engineered the entire run to reach this alliance, and resolves to reset and do better.

plotlines.title: Gotcha
plotlines.summary: As Len rigs the transfer armor onto Ryan in the flooding underwater base, a recovered Felix listens in and deduces Ryan's time-travel, making peace with the loss of Fortuna once he learns Ryan will save her. He asks Ryan to help him understand and reconcile with his sister next loop. Alphonse Manada's Dynamis submarine arrives and demands Len 'dead or alive,' revealing his goal to democratize Elixirs (make everyone a Genome to break warlord monopolies) with Len as the key; he threatens to flood the base and children to force her. Len refuses ('better dead than corpo') and, under bombardment, triggers the transfer. Ryan freezes time, Violet Flux builds, and the loop ends, resetting to May 8th 2020. In the fresh loop the guiding entity is gone (Chronoradio plays only music). Len's voice confirms she REMEMBERS, Ryan's centuries of solitude finally broken and the transfer a success. But she urgently, sickly summons him to the orphanage; when he arrives she is nosebleeding with cold soulless eyes, shoots him, and traps him in a water-sphere. The transfer worked, but something else hitched a ride back inside her.

plotlines.title: Captured in Mechron's Bunker
plotlines.summary: Ryan wakes naked and thoroughly restrained in a Mechron torture chair inside the bunker, held by the Meta-Gang: Big Fat Adam, Psyshock, Ghoul, and Sarin. The chair keeps him alive against his will, blocking his suicide-reload escape. Adam reveals Len is now Psyshock's thrall: he had Psyshock booby-trap the Dynamis brain-tech so any overwritten mind becomes a host, this triggers only on the overwrite step, so Livia still holds a clean backup of Len's mind in the Blue World. Psyshock taunts Ryan with Len's private memories while Adam debates whether to overwrite Ryan or take another route.

plotlines.title: Adam's Real Plan and the Black Elixir Gambit
plotlines.summary: Ryan deduces Adam's manipulations: Adam gaslights his own lieutenants and his true goal is the bunker's Orbital Communications Tower, not a Psycho cure, he wants to kill everyone. Adam reveals a horror dessert: Little Sarah bound on a plate. Rather than risk Psyshock's uncertain overwrite, Adam produces the Black Elixir, planning to force Ryan to become a Psycho and corrupt his save-point power (Ryan never dared take a second Elixir for that reason). The Elixir wriggles, remembering Ryan. Explosions rock the bunker; Sarin, her faith in Adam broken, secretly asks Ryan for a cure and rusts his restraints. Ghoul opens the door to reveal the corridor slaughtered and Ryan's savior: the possessed Bahamut plushie, declaring 'I will always be your friend!'

plotlines.title: The Bahamut's Rampage and the Shoggoth Bargain
plotlines.summary: The possessed Bahamut plushie tears through the Meta-Gang: it vaporizes Psyshock and, when Adam raises the Black Elixir to corrupt Ryan, Sarin betrays and air-blasts Adam into the shattered bottle. Adam and the immortal Ghoul are both devoured, and the paradox stabilizes the Black Elixir into a sentient shoggoth pleading to be sent 'back to the Black.' Ryan bargains help-for-help; the shoggoth clears the bunker of thralls. The Bahamut duplicates, freeing Little Sarah, ruining the run beyond repair. Rather than reset, Ryan resolves on a 'Meta Run': take over the bunker, free the children, and build a Psycho cure.

plotlines.title: Conning Frank the Mad
plotlines.summary: Armed with a hammer, laser gun, and Bliss and joined by the defected Sarin, Ryan sets out to free the caged orphanage children and implode the leaderless Meta-Gang. Cornered by the metal-immune schizophrenic giant Frank the Mad and a surviving Psyshock host, Ryan exploits Frank's Cold-War delusions: posing as 'CIA agent Romano,' he frames Psyshock as a communist traitor who murdered 'President Adam,' planting the bloody hammer in his tentacles. When Psyshock contradicts Frank's delusion, the enraged giant punches his head apart and storms off to hunt the new host. Ryan reaches the infirmary, arms up, and, as child-obsessed plushies mass toward the caged kids, his first Meta Run begins 'with chaos and madness.'

Cornered by the metal-immune schizophrenic giant Frank the Mad and a surviving Psyshock host, Ryan exploits Frank's Cold-War delusions: posing as 'CIA agent Romano,' he frames Psyshock as a communist traitor who murdered 'President Adam,' planting the bloody hammer in his tentacles. When Psyshock contradicts Frank's delusion, the enraged giant punches his head apart and storms off to hunt the new host. Ryan reaches the infirmary, arms up, and, as child-obsessed plushies mass toward the caged kids, his first Meta Run begins 'with chaos and madness.'

plotlines.title: The Bunker Civil War
plotlines.summary: Ryan, Sarin, the plushies, and the Black Elixir shoggoth storm the bunker's upper levels, where Frank's rampage has already routed Psyshock's forces. The leaderless Meta-Gang implodes: Mosquito, Rakshasa, Ink Machine and others switch to Ryan's winning side against Psyshock. Ryan chases the fleeing brainjacker through the hangars (past his engine-stripped Plymouth), sniping each host as Psyshock hops bodies. Psyshock takes the enthralled Len hostage with a drill to her temple; Ryan time-stops and strikes her carotid to knock her out safely, then paralyzes Psyshock's brain-tissue body with a full Bliss dose and captures him.

plotlines.title: President Ryan Goes Full Bond Villain
plotlines.summary: After an hour of one-sided slaughter, the bunker belongs to Ryan. Standing atop Mechron's mech, he crowns himself 'President' of the ~20 surviving Psychos, ruling through mock-democracy, the Elixir supply ('Elixicare'), and the threat of his shoggoth. He forms a cabinet (Sarin VP, the Black Elixir secretary of state, Frank enforcer, Rakshasa feeding gremlins to the child-bonded plushies), keeps Len and the thralls sedated for later de-brainwashing, holds Psyshock for Cancel, and reassures Little Sarah he'll cure her mother. Since the run is doomed, he decides to throw caution aside, call in favors, seize the bunker's doomsday weapon, and aim for 'the woooooorld', sending for his white Persian cat to complete the villain aesthetic.

plotlines.title: President Ryan Assembles His Scheme
plotlines.summary: Ruling the bunker as 'Mr. President,' Ryan cracks Adam and Psyshock's files, learning the Meta-Gang found the bunker by tracing a research probe's signal to New Rome, and grasping that whoever unlocks the central mainframe could dominate the world. He recruits Geniuses by phone: the Architect (Nora Moore) to stress-test the bunker's tech and line up a cashmere costume from Wardrobe; Vulcan (Jasmine) to arm a war on Dynamis, on the condition he first trashes the Wyvern movie at Star Studio; and, swallowing old betrayal, Alchemo/Braindead to fix the memory-transfer machine for Len (Alchemo insisting on bringing 'the Doll'). Livia agrees to a neutral meeting, and Minerva accepts a live peace offering to the Augusti. Cure theory forms: pair Mongrel and a two-color survivor with Dr. Tyrano.

plotlines.title: Darkling and the Cosmology of the Ultimate Ones
plotlines.summary: Ryan visits the Black Elixir, learning it is an eighth-color Elixir of pure paradox that cannot be bound and finds our causal universe a maddening 'molecule-shaped prison.' It reveals the cosmology: Ultimate Ones, one per colored higher dimension, are supreme beings the Elixirs serve as priest-conduits so mortals may ascend (the Alchemist's true goal, Augustus its warning). It wants to return through a bunker portal to the Black World and ask the Black Ultimate One to erase its arrival. It confirms Ryan's power comes from the Violet Ultimate One, making Ryan the timeline's Observer, and that this god 'nudges' rather than controls, no longer actively interfering, leaving Ryan free and alone. It hints an Ultimate One could even restore the erased (Jasmine), but at a reality-damaging price. Ryan names it 'Darkling,' which it sulkily accepts.

plotlines.title: Peace Offering to the Augusti
plotlines.summary: Ryan meets Livia at Deadland Motel and gifts her the drugged Psyshock; Cancel negates his power and Mortimer executes him, freeing his thralls. Under the truth-teller Luigi, Ryan spitefully rants his entire history (time travel, Monaco, Darkling, the doomed loop), triggering Luigi's existential crisis; Livia pays Luigi 20M euros to leave the city forever. Ryan confirms Cancel's true mechanic (severing the Elixir-dimension link, lethal to his Purple-dependent power) and theorizes Augustus's invulnerability is an anomalous metal-mimicking Orange mutation.

plotlines.title: An Alliance and Its Limits
plotlines.summary: Convinced, Livia freely gives Ryan Len's uncorrupted brain-map, no strings, honoring her past self's debt, and commits to partnership toward a 'perfect ending,' agreeing to consider helping cure Psychos via her two-power secret. Her limits: only a week or two before her family retakes Rust Town; she wants Augustus retired, not killed; and she's in denial over Felix, meaning to try to win him back this loop. She warns of mysterious Augusti assassinations, which Ryan recognizes as the Shroud, now on a lone spree, believing Ryan turned Psycho. Returning, Ryan learns Psyshock scrambled Len's brain into a vegetable on his way out, forcing him to rely on Alchemo, and turns to cracking the bunker with the Architect's 35-page report.

plotlines.title: Manada's Ultimatum
plotlines.summary: In a tense video call, Dynamis CEO Hector Manada refuses to renew the knockoff-Elixir supply, revealing Psyshock had been secretly taking over Dynamis by brainwashing his staff, treachery his death exposed. Manada calls Ryan's blackmail bluffs (recordings; the knockoffs' Bloodstream/Lab 66 link) and gives him 48 hours to release the technicians, return the tech, and leave town, or face Il Migliore. Ryan, unable to keep the juice flowing, resolves instead to storm the bunker's mainframe, using Manada's 48-hour window as cover.

plotlines.title: Alchemo, the Doll, and Diagnosing Len
plotlines.summary: Alchemo arrives with his android daughter Tea (the Doll, Ryan's ex, who slaps then forgives him) and Ryan's old toaster-robot Toasty. Amid the awkward reunion, Alchemo treats the captive Acid Rain's brain tumors and agrees, at the Doll's urging, to help cure Psychos and Mechron-plague tumors. Examining the comatose Len, he confirms Psyshock's repeated overwrites nearly shut down her brain and she won't wake on her own; he can't repair Dynamis's booby-trapped machine but can build a working copy, if he can access the bunker's central Universal Brain and matter replicator. Ryan commits to assaulting the mainframe, with Frank guarding the non-combatant Genius.

plotlines.title: Storming the Mainframe
plotlines.summary: Clad in Wardrobe's new black-and-red presidential war-suit, Ryan leads a strike team (Sarin, Alchemo, Darkling, Frank, and expendable Psychos) through Nora's shortcut into the bunker to seize the mainframe and let Alchemo interface with it. They face Mechron's learning hivemind: cyclopean androids, drones, and turrets that adapt within minutes and kill Gemini, Ink Machine, and the Reptilian. Frank and Darkling hold the rear while Sarin rusts through walls; Darkling devours a telekinetic vat-boss and its Red Elixir. In the command room Alchemo hijacks the Universal Brain, registers the team as 'staff,' shuts down the defenses, and unlocks Mechron's entire research database.

plotlines.title: Len Wakes, and Ryan Breaks
plotlines.summary: Using the bunker's replicator, Alchemo builds a working transfer machine and restores Len with Livia's clean brain-map, repairing the overuse damage. After Tea gently ushers Little Sarah out, Ryan sits alone with Len as she wakes with full recognition, rejoicing that the transfer worked. The centuries of buried loneliness finally crash down and Ryan collapses in tears, unable to speak. Len holds him as she did in childhood and tells him he's not alone, and for the first time since he began looping, he isn't.

plotlines.title: Chekhov's Gun Falls on New Rome
plotlines.summary: After Mortimer coldly executes Wardrobe, Len bubbles the enraged Reload and, grieving, begs Ryan to leave the doomed city with her, finally admitting she wants him back in her life. As Livia's people evacuate by bathysphere, the Shroud abducts Narcinia mid-loading on Felix's behalf, and Livia senses her alternate selves dying to an incoming secret weapon. A pillar of light falls from orbit; Ryan blacks out and wakes alone in the rerouted escape pod beneath the sea. Surfacing, he sees New Rome ablaze, Mount Augustus a crater, and Dynamis's towers annihilated by repeated orbital strikes. He realizes Big Fat Adam has thrown his own men into the meat-grinder, unlocked Mechron's bunker, and seized its Orbital Communications Center weapon. Ryan waited too long.

plotlines.title: Happiness Overdose
plotlines.summary: Ryan wakes at peace for the first time in centuries, uncharacteristically kind to Frank and his minions, and declares a day off before tomorrow's assault on Dynamis, racing Manada's expiring ultimatum. Alchemo's cured Acid Rain (now the meek 'Helen') and Mongrel emerge; Helen reveals her teleport passes through the Purple World where she glimpses the watching pyramid and a closed 'pathway' inside Ryan, and recounts Adam force-feeding her a Violet Elixir. Ryan swears to help her though he can't restore her family.

plotlines.title: Family, Not Lovers
plotlines.summary: In Len's new bunker workshop, Ryan confesses he loves her and wants to build a life together; Len, clear-headed on Alchemo's antidepressants, gently declines romance but insists he stay in her life, reframing them as family. They plan the endgame: the transfer machine sends only one brain-map per loop, so they'll need Livia for external memory storage and Vulcan's or the bunker's tech to rebuild the scanner. Next target: raiding Dynamis's Lab Sixty-Six.

plotlines.title: Goodbye, Monaco!
plotlines.summary: Flashback to Ryan's self-appointed 'Perfect Run': after years of loops mapping Monaco's pocket dimension (proving nukes, drones, and animals can't break or bypass it) he realizes 'I am an exit' and spends five years building the Resonators from CERN parts. On April 27th he plants one in Simon's tunnel to tear open an escape portal, single-handedly massacres the entire clown garrison and its circus minibosses as 'Quicksave', and evacuates ~40 captives including Simon and Martine. Simon survives, stays to fence off Monaco, and gifts Ryan Nietzsche's 'Thus Spoke Zarathustra'. Ryan detonates the Resonator's nuke behind them and, knowing these people he lived a century beside will never truly know him, freezes time to absorb every memory before driving into the sunset, his Perfect Run complete.

plotlines.title: Lonely Together
plotlines.summary: On the Rust Town pier, Ryan and Livia bond over their mirrored isolation -- both know everyone around them yet are truly known by no one. Livia, having confirmed Felix will never love her back, agrees to Ryan's endgame: use her time-leap to preserve memories, co-develop a cure for the Psycho condition (on condition she's involved throughout), and disguise herself as the supervillain 'Queen Crimson' to join tomorrow's Star Studios raid. She warns that Leo Hargraves and Dynamis are converging on Rust Town in her visions.

plotlines.title: The Screaming Knockoff
plotlines.summary: In the bunker lab, Len insists on testing whether Dynamis's knockoff Elixirs are made from her father. A drop of her blood makes the green 'Hercules' knockoff scream, turn bloody red, and bloat into Bloodstream's face reaching for its 'lost daughter'. Alchemo's flamethrowers incinerate it as Len relives her trauma, clawing her cheeks bloody, and Ryan holds her. The horror confirmed: Dynamis packaged Bloodstream into a product, and unknown numbers of New Romans have unknowingly drunk Elixirs made from a human being.

plotlines.title: Good Morning New Rome
plotlines.summary: As Hector Manada's ultimatum expires, Ryan launches his 'full supervillain' plan: the Meta-Gang (Ryan as Mr. President, Livia debuting as Queen Crimson, the Doll, Sarin, Frank, and a 'Beefcake'-enhanced Mosquito) crashes Dynamis's Star Studios and seizes the live news set. On air Ryan broadcasts his edited confrontation with Manada and the Bloodstream-knockoff footage (exposing that ~10% of New Rome carries a Bloodstream clone), threatens the city with a mini A-bomb, performs a stop-motion figurine parody, and demands a ludicrous one-million-dollar ransom. Len, shattered by the knockoff test, refuses to come. Wyvern races toward the studio just as Eugène-Henry the cat bats the A-bomb's button and starts the countdown.

plotlines.title: Corporate Raid
plotlines.summary: Dynamis's counterattack hits the Star Studios raiders: Wyvern duels the Beefcake-Mosquito while Private Security and heroes (Atom Cat/Felix, Reload, Wardrobe) surround the truck. Ryan turns it into theater, recruiting Wardrobe as his willing lifelong archenemy, dodging Felix's kill-touch, and out-juggling Wardrobe's costume-theft with three mass-produced A-bombs to force Wyvern to stand down. Livia (Queen Crimson) foresees and punches the invisible Shroud, who confesses the glass-vigilantes only 'delayed', not stopped, Bloodstream's return. Ryan hands Wyvern a syringe of Len's blood as proof against Dynamis, spares Felix per his promise to Livia, and the gang escapes with the ransom pending.

plotlines.title: Happy Birthday
plotlines.summary: Fleeing back to Rust Town, the crew finds the Private Security checkpoint massacred: ~24 guards hung from an archway by their own intestines, '885' scrawled in blood, and 'HAPPY BIRTHDAY!' spelled one letter per corpse. Livia's foresight had gone blind to it. Ryan realizes the escaped Killer Rabbit Plushie has surfaced, dooming this run, as its pointed ears rise behind him in the truck's rear-view mirror.

plotlines.title: R&D
plotlines.summary: CH83: With Rust Town under siege (but its underwater bunker access secretly edited out of the plans Ryan sent Nora), Vulcan flies in past her own blockade and agrees to build Ryan's magnum opus: a power-boosting cashmere armor using Mechron's tech, the matter replicator, and Len's signal tech, meant to let him carry multiple people back in time. Alchemo's bio-scans then crack the Psycho puzzle: Livia's two Elixirs coexist because her genome (Neanderthal DNA/chimerism) fools them into thinking they bonded to two people. The cure would reproduce Mongrel's Elixir-control power via gene therapy, but needs Dr. Tyrano, who is shielded by Fallout.

Meanwhile Livia safely records brainmaps at her father's, Len evacuates the children by bathysphere, and Alchemo backs up the Doll and struggles to record Sarin (whose memories are molecular, not neural). plotlines.title: The Public Defection
plotlines.summary: CH83: Dynamis's damage-control press conference backfires spectacularly. Wyvern goes off-script, confirms the Knockoff Elixir crime is real ('I have checked'), and resigns as Il Migliore's leader on principle. Felix walks out of Dynamis; Enrique Manada stays silent as if he'd long wanted to say it. Ryan's exposure gambit lands: 'all according to keikaku.' The chapter closes on betrayal: Sarin eavesdrops on the cure/endgame talk and levels her vibrating gauntlet at Ryan, a turn Livia foresaw.

plotlines.title: Left Behind
plotlines.summary: CH84: Sarin's mutiny forces Ryan's biggest psychological turning point. She refuses to let him reload until he cures her, revealing her tragedy (six months to reform from dispersed wind, years sealed in a cloth prison, 'my name is not Sarin, I want my life back'), then breaks down after a warning shot. Alchemo, exposed for reading the Doll's memory-map, refuses to be judged by his other self's madness and offers to copy minds. Livia (who foresaw Sarin killing her and Alchemo) and the Doll's love push Ryan to finally keep his loop-bonds: for the first time he agrees to carry vetted companions forward via Livia's brainmap backups before the coming point of no return. 'Hell is loneliness,' not other people.

He warns it is almost time to open Darkling's gate home and raid Lab Sixty-Six to face whatever remains of her father, who may be cured, dead, or a harvested Knockoff source. Len grabs her rifle and resolves to go: 'Let's go.'

He warns it is almost time to open Darkling's gate home and raid Lab Sixty-Six to face whatever remains of her father, who may be cured, dead, or a harvested Knockoff source. Len grabs her rifle and resolves to go: 'Let's go.'

plotlines.title: The Light Beyond
plotlines.summary: CH85: Ryan uses the bunker's particle collider to open a gate to the Black World and send Darkling home; the shoggoth reverts to its true impossible form. The Black Ultimate One tempts Ryan to ascend and shed his flesh forever, luring him with the voices of his dead (Jasmine, Simon, Felix) and the promise of undoing every erasure. In the abyss his own violet phantom speaks and reveals it is his Elixir, his other half, granting the unbreakable wish he made at bonding (to return to the past). Ryan chooses the living over the dead, refuses ascension, and returns radiating Black particles alongside violet. Darkling vows to wait for him at the end.

plotlines.title: The Second Power
plotlines.summary: CH86: Aboard the submarine, Ryan, Vulcan, and Alchemo study the Black Flux he brought back from the Black World. The Saturn Armor detects it only in frozen time; its readings self-alter after recording and refuse categorization, warping reality when insisted upon, yet Ryan's bioscan still reads as an ordinary Violet Genome. Vulcan suspects a dormant secondary power linked to the Black World, but Ryan cannot activate or understand it ('UNLIMITED POWAH' does nothing). Alchemo gives up theorizing.

plotlines.title: The End Times
plotlines.summary: CH86: The Lab Sixty-Six raid launches against a burning New Rome. Ryan forgives Alchemo (a final second chance, brainmap to Livia) and confesses to Len this is his TWELFTH world-ending, swearing no thirteenth ('together till the end'). The killer-plushie army has escalated into open war on Mount Augustus (the Leporimachia), overrunning Augustus's hill faster than he can cull it. Vulcan departs on Augustus's orders, scrambles Dynamis comms, and warns that Fallout is recalled and ~1-2 hours out. Sarin's rousing speech rallies the demoralized gang, and Ryan leads the assault on the Dynamis tower to grab Dr. Tyrano and torch Lab 66.

CH87: Ryan's crew crashes into Dynamis HQ and fights up to Lab 66. Incognito's earlier server infiltration lets them reprogram every keycard. Devilry is downed by Mosquito and Acid Rain; the final guardians (the terrified kung-fu Panda, the hero Reload, and Wardrobe) are trapped in Len's water bubbles. Ryan and Wardrobe have a costume duel he wins by cheating a time-stop, then he playfully proposes marriage and she refuses (Dynamis holds her girlfriend Nora hostage, so she only token-defends). Sarin blasts open Lab 66, revealing the automated Knockoff Elixir assembly line. But before they breach Dr. Tyrano's inner door, Fallout drills in early, having killed Mosquito on the roof: 'Time to die.'

CH88: the Fallout boss fight. Ryan's crew battles Atom Smasher (Fallout) through the Knockoff factory, past cloning pods holding modified template clones (Wyvern, Devilry, Windsweep, an embryo Panda) used as living organ processors. Ryan traps Fallout in Mechron nanomachine goo, but the cyborg overrides his safeties and becomes a blackened flaming skeleton of pure Red Flux, Hargraves-durable, melting the floor. He bisects and kills Mongrel. Frank tackles him and Sarin (real name Bianca) charges him like a suicide bomber to buy Ryan time; the collapsing ceiling buries Frank, Sarin, and Fallout alive. Ryan notes his Black Flux devours Fallout's Red Flux, and vows to save Sarin next loop.

CH91 (loop climax): In Lab 66 Ryan confirms Dynamis has held a neutered Bloodstream since 2016, nationalizes Dr. Tyrano and the Knockoff cure, and downloads the vaccine + email codes for next loop. But Len, infected by proximity, shoots the aquarium and merges with her father; Bloodstream detonates into a rangeless world-plague, devouring Len and Tyrano and reverting every Knockoff in New Rome. Enrique (breaking with Hector) and Fallout are engulfed. Ryan flees as the city, then the planet, turns red.

plotlines.title: Bloodstream Reunion
plotlines.summary: CH88: Ryan captures Dr. Tyrano at gunpoint to open the inner bioscanner door, learning Tyrano's true goal is a Knockoff that turns humans into dinosaurs. Behind the door, at the heart of Lab 66, is the source of all Knockoffs: Bloodstream, Len's father, survived as a house-sized red shoggoth in a mechanical aquarium wired into the whole system. Len drops her rifle and rushes to the glass; the blob's eyes find his daughter. Blood calls to blood.

plotlines.title: Origin Loop: Bloodstream's Last Stand
plotlines.summary: CH89 (flashback to Ryan's first, powerless life as 'Cesare'): Leo Hargraves briefs the Carnival on their target Freddie Sabino / Bloodstream, a Green/Blue Psycho who lives in every blood cell and converts anyone he infects into a copy of himself. Meanwhile Ryan and Len hide with the delusional Bloodstream in Porto Venere, building the submarine Laika to flee to America. Ryan endures Bloodstream's love-and-abuse, learns the Psycho plans to kill everyone if his children die, and secretly resolves he must die. Stitch delivers the doom reveal: Bloodstream's limits are only psychological, and if Len dies he becomes an extinction-level plague. Ryan baits the Carnival to the hideout, forces Len onto the Laika alone, returns to die beside Bloodstream, and injects his Violet Elixir for the very first time. The world turns purple, and Ryan runs, the birth of his time loop.

plotlines.title: Origin Loop: The First Run
plotlines.summary: CH90: Ryan discovers his power mid-battle as the Carnival (Leo, the Cossack, Mr. Wave) fights Bloodstream at Porto Venere's Marina, a 10-second time-stop with a 10-second cooldown. In his first try he steps out and shouts for them to stop; the distraction lets Bloodstream kill Ace and, no longer knowing 'Cesare,' crush Ryan's skull, his first death. He wakes rewound to a checkpoint: his power creates a save-point. On the reload he hides, lets Leo's fireball incinerate Bloodstream's last clone (Ace survives), but can't outrun the blast and dies again, waking in the Carnival infirmary. Len and the Laika are long gone; Ryan loops the explosion endlessly, never catching her, and is left utterly alone. Epilogue: Enrique and Alphonse Manada reveal Dynamis secretly backed the hunt and knew the god-tier genetic-rewrite power of Bloodstream's blood, the seed of the Knockoffs.

plotlines.title: Paradox: The Reset
plotlines.summary: CH91: fleeing the apocalypse, Ryan meets Augustus, who won the Lepiromachia and vaporizes Mr. See-Through while ignoring the world's end to hunt Leo Hargraves. Ryan's Saturn armor absorbs a lightning bolt and he punches Augustus with Black-and-violet particles, the tyrant recoils ('I felt that'), the first blow to ever reach him. Ryan realizes the Black Ultimate One's wish is a paradox: the power to kill immortals. He reaches Livia's turret-ringed Sorrento safehouse, completes her brainmap memory transfer via the Chronoradio as Augustus closes in, and resets, unsure his power is even the same now the Black World runs through him.

plotlines.title: The Perfect Run Plan
plotlines.summary: CH92: a new loop begins with Ryan's cathartic revenge rounds (Ghoul, Night Terror, adopting Henriette). Reunited with the now-memory-carrying Livia (who pranks him with a fake villain-betrayal speech), the two become co-strategists. Livia's simulations date the three overlapping calamities, the Meta-Gang seizing Mechron's satellite (~May 12-18), Augustus's war with the incoming Carnival (~May 28), and the Bloodstream pandemic (odds spike if Alphonse takes over Dynamis). They map the perfect-run sequence: Ryan joins Augustus's mob as a Carnival double-agent, rebuilds the mind-transfer machine via Vulcan, returns Narcinia to appease the Carnival, and has Stitch/Tyrano weaponize the Knockoff vaccine to erase Bloodstream. Ryan radios Len that her father lives; she answers with cold determination: 'Meet me at the orphanage.'
