They map the perfect-run sequence: Ryan joins Augustus's mob as a Carnival double-agent, rebuilds the mind-transfer machine via Vulcan, returns Narcinia to appease the Carnival, and has Stitch/Tyrano weaponize the Knockoff vaccine to erase Bloodstream. Ryan radios Len that her father lives; she answers with cold determination: 'Meet me at the orphanage.'

CH93 'Defenders of the Realm': Ryan recruits his alliance for the perfect run. On the orphanage roof he tells amnesiac Len the full truth (time travel, her death, her father as Bloodstream, her infection possibly shaping her feelings) and seeks her consent for the memory transfer; she wavers but believes him. He discovers the Killer Rabbit Plushie, so thoroughly beaten by Augustus in the Leporimachia, has lost its will to kill (given 'depression'), and realizes it was never truly bound. He recruits Shroud/Mathias Martel, proving the Knockoff-Bloodstream link with Len's blood and taking a leap of faith to confirm his chronokinetic looping; Mathias reveals his mother is the seer Pythia (Alice Martel, alive in Denmark) and that Augustus is fated to wage an all-out war to leave Livia 'queen of the ashes.' Ryan plans to sic Sunshine on Mechron's other bases (to self-detonate the Bahamut), flip Enrique/Blackthorn against Hector and Fallout, and reserve Augustus for himself. He recruits the Panda (Timmy) last.

CH94 'Cheat Code' (May 10th): Ryan executes the revised loop. He preempts Psyshock's Meta-Gang raid on the orphanage, freezing time to bubble Mosquito and Mongrel and huffing Psyshock full of Bliss in under a minute, then captures them for Len's crush-depth underwater asylum instead of killing them. His Avengers assemble (Len, the Panda, Shroud) and forge a temporary alliance with Livia's team (Queen Crimson, Fortuna, Cancel) to destroy the Meta-Gang's cache of Mechron weapons before Adam the Ogre can use it. Ryan's key gambit: deploy Fortuna's luck-Elixir as a 'living cheat code' to crack Mechron's mainframe. Livia (who reveals she knows Shroud's identity) times the strike from Ryan's intel, Cancel's execution of Psyshock to coincide with the Junkyard assault, and the team drives out to attack the bunker.

CH95 'Double Date': the Junkyard raid. Ryan masks the team's approach with Ghoul's severed foot so the Land mistakes the Plymouth Fury for her returning tenant. On Livia's cue Cancel executes Psyshock, freeing his thralls and sowing chaos. Ryan, Livia, the Panda, Shroud, Fortuna and Len blitz the base: Fortuna's luck bubbles the Reptilian, Livia's foresight hard-counters and captures Acid Rain (Helen), and Shroud flies Fortuna clear of the Land's terrakinesis. Ryan and Livia fight in flawless synergy (flirting mid-battle) to breach the blast door, which the Land seals behind them, trapping them inside. Len assaults from the sea access. The team reaches the recreational atrium and comes face-to-face with Adam the Ogre, Sarin and Frank the Mad, Adam wielding a salvaged Mechron cannon.

CH96 'Beast of the East': the bunker boss fight. Adam the Ogre wields a salvaged Mechron gravity gun and brainwashes Frank with a 'protect democracy' delusion. Ryan learns his Fisty punch can't focus Black Flux without the Saturn armor, and turns Sarin (Bianca) to his side by disarming and offering her a cure. Livia foresees the winning branch: she IDs Adam's skin-only defense (head trauma works), mentally shatters Frank by exposing his true name Vladimir Khabarov, and lets the Panda absorb Adam's Blue Elixir, gaining a second power and finishing Adam with a 'Soaring Panda' kick (Len later drowns him). The Meta-Gang is jailed underwater pending a cure. A near-flawless victory. Ryan then plots infiltrating Dynamis via Jamie/Ki-jung/Lanka and rebuilding the Saturn armor with Vulcan, and finally asks Livia on a date.

CH97 'A Breath of Fresh Air' (day after the raid): Ryan consolidates. He recruits Dr. Tyrano remotely for the Psycho-cure research (dangling a dinosaur Knockoff), though Tyrano is bound to Dynamis and can't sabotage the Knockoff supply, so Lab 66 must still be assaulted. He gives the real A-bomb to Vulcan (becoming her assistant) and a decoy to the suicidal plushie. With Shroud he maps the Dynamis endgame: flip Enrique, but Alphonse/Fallout won't surrender Bloodstream's power give-and-take monopoly, so Ryan will stop him with an upgraded Saturn armor. Len's tests reveal the Panda's second power is accelerated learning (mastering origami, French, and Bruce Lee's kick in half an hour). Ryan reassures Len she's family forever, and she finally consents to the memory transfer and to having her father's blood tracker removed, learning to 'let the dead rest.' Ryan leaves for his date with Livia.

CH98 'White Night': Ryan takes Livia on their date to the Midnight Road, a thin place he reaches via his car's particle accelerator. There he confides his deepest secret, that he once lived an entire full lifetime trapped in the Monaco anomaly and has never dared have a family, making Livia his sole confidant. Livia, freed of her foresight because she cannot predict him, vows to stop her father Augustus's coming war and to share Ryan's burden. She then brings Ryan into Augustus's villa on Mount Augustus and into her bed, an open act of rebellion, and they spend the night together, cementing their bond as partners.

CH99 'How I Met Your Daughter': the morning after, Ryan is caught cooking breakfast in Augustus's villa. He taunts the tyrant with repeated time-stops before confirming he slept with Livia, and Augustus electrocutes him, confirming Ryan still needs the Saturn Armor to harm the invincible mob boss. Livia rushes in, uses her foresight power on her father to save Ryan, and openly claims him as her boyfriend, revealing she knows Augustus murdered Narcinia's parents. When she threatens to abandon the Augusti empire forever if he harms Ryan or Felix, the shaken tyrant relents and grudgingly tolerates Ryan under a triple death-threat, turning a would-be enemy into a reluctant father-in-law and further entrenching Ryan's alliance with Livia.

CH100 'Past Fragment: No Planet for Old Men' (a ~2005 flashback, origin lore): Cardinal Andreas Torque, Inquisitor-General of the Vatican's secret Malleus Maleficarum, investigates the pre-Genome-age incidents (the Stanford Incident and worldwide monster outbreaks) and tracks the immortal teleporting geneticist Eva Fabre, revealed to be a legion of blue-particle copies who calls herself the Alchemist and is seeding the Elixirs to force mankind's evolution. Her hive wipes out his order and captures him; dosed with Janus Augusti's mind-opening crystals and a Blue Elixir, Torque's soul ascends into the Blue World and melds with the Ultimate One, the psionic information-god at its center, an experience of divine rapture that leaves him a broken addict craving only to return as the old world burns. This exposes the true origin of the Genome age, the Alchemist, the Blue World deity, and the Augusti dynasty's complicity.

CH101 'Lover's Breath': Ryan and Livia formalize their romance, she agrees to be his girlfriend on the condition it last until they choose to end it rather than until a reset. Reviewing Ryan's Perfect Run to-do list, Livia adds 'Be happy too' and bans his suicide-reloads and drugs, and crucially connects Ryan's Purple-World vision of an icebound Alchemist fortress to Station Orpheon, France's secret Antarctic base, revealing Bacchus was 'twisted' investigating the Alchemist before Last Easter. At the Augusti-owned Triton's Resort, Ryan meets Mars (Luca Veran) and is healed by Venus (Andrea Julani-Veran), learning the resort is a prostitution/Bliss-addiction front, and resolves to eventually bring down Augustus and the Veran clan to free Livia while reforming the empire.

CH102 'Moving On': after the successful Mechron-mainframe raid (won on Fortuna's luck), Ryan consolidates his gains. Alchemo completes Len's improved memory transfer (coexisting memories) and Stitch, aided by Dr. Tyrano, develops an airborne Psycho vaccine and a viral Bliss cure; the Panda's accelerated learning makes him a lab assistant. Ryan counsels Shroud through his rift with Fortuna, and Len, now recalling that Bloodstream killed her, asks to delay the Dynamis raid until she's certain her father is beyond saving. Ryan sets the next arc: hit the Bliss Factory, blow the bunker, and flee New Rome for Antarctica (Station Orpheon) via Monaco to find the source of the Psycho cure and rebuild the Saturn Armor. Len accepts Ryan's romance with Livia, and both resolve to stop living in the past and move on together.

CH103 'Drug Bust': scouting Ischia's Bliss Superlab during Vulcan's security inspection, Ryan discovers Bacchus is Andreas Torque, the ascended ex-Cardinal from CH100, a Bliss-cooking fanatic who reveres the Alchemist/Eva Fabre as a prophet and craves return to the Blue Ultimate One. Ryan extracts Station Orpheon's coordinates (Bacchus believes it emptied after a violet flash) and, sickened by the priest's endorsement of Bliss's mass sterilization, commits to razing the lab. Donning improved Saturn armor, he stages the assault with Len, Sarin, and Shroud while the Augusti high command attends the Olympians meeting, noticing his Black Flux power has grown stronger between loops. Mr. Wave arrives as a surprise ally.

CH104 'Return of the Cashmere': the Carnival-route assault razes Ischia's Bliss Factory. Sarin (gaseous) sabotages defenses overnight; then Len's Cthulhu-mech, Sarin's new rust-proof armor, Mr. Wave, and King Saturn (Ryan) storm the fortress while Shroud infiltrates on Livia's codes. Ryan discovers his Black Flux only works during time-stop and uses it to crack, then split, the immortal ghost Geist, who begs joyfully for the death he's craved for 15 years. With Geist gone the factory falls in minutes; Shroud downloads the production data, wipes footage, and feeds Vulcan a cover story. Deeper in they find Bacchus's secret pens of ~23 mind-scrambled human Bliss test subjects. Ryan photographs the atrocity, frees them, and vows to bury the factory with Bacchus inside on his Perfect Run.

CH105 'Miracle Cure': in the raid's aftermath Augustus decimates his own guards. The Psycho Cure is proven on Knockoff Psychos (Mongrel and Mosquito revert to healthy Genomes) but fails on two-true-Elixir Psychos like Frank, so Ryan launches an Antarctica expedition (Stitch joining) to research Elixir bonding via the Alchemist. Len, healing and shedding her red iconography, resolves to euthanize her father Bloodstream herself if uncurable. Ryan uses Incognito as a decoy alibi, then confesses to Livia that his Black Flux could neutralize Augustus. After her ultimatum, he swears not to KILL her father but to break and imprison him decisively - a fraught compromise between saving the world and sparing her family.

CH106 'Mice Trap': the Veran manor dinner is Augustus's assassination trap. Suspecting the Bliss raid was an inside job (Ryan slipped 'Dynamis' fighting Geist), Augustus sends Cancel/Greta to blind Livia's precognition and suppress Ryan's time-stop, and orders Mars to kill Mathias/Shroud once a chimney assassin is in place. Ryan silently unnerves Night Terror into abandoning his post. Livia reveals she deliberately let this possibility stand so Narcinia would witness her family's murderousness (the price of the rare peaceful future where Augustus retires and Enrique Manada takes Dynamis), warns Ryan of the assassin, sets a Sorrento rendezvous, and distracts Cancel. The trap springs when Atom Kitty/Felix - come to smuggle Narcinia out - tumbles down the chimney into the room.

CH107 'Black Dinner': the trap springs. Felix arrives to extract Narcinia; Augustus (called 'Janus' by Mars) orders his godson executed as the presumed Ischia leak. Ryan freezes time to block Mortimer's assassination shot and hauls Felix out the window under Mars's glass storm. He downs Night Terror (whose fake-Augustus illusion nearly fools them) and exposes Venus impersonating Livia's face and voice, pinning her hand with a knife via the 'Master Ryan' passphrase. A car chase erupts through New Rome: Mars, revealed to wield a pocket-dimension armory of thousands of weapons hurled ~1km and self-repairing his motorcycle, pursues with Mortimer and Sparrow, callously killing civilians. Felix, crushed that his parents tried to kill him, reveals he brought backup - Wyvern and Private Security arrive as Livia sets a Sorrento rendezvous.

CH108 'Go Daddy Go': the Strip chase climaxes. Wyvern, Wardrobe (whistle freezes all traffic), and Private Security aid Ryan and Felix against Mars and Sparrow; Ryan wields the Killer Rabbit Plushie as a laser and downs Mortimer. Felix, realizing Livia foresaw and staged his rescue, is bitter but alive. At the decisive moment Jamie - torn between his light-sword and his conscience - cuts Mars's grappling chains instead of Felix, defecting from the Augusti; Mars crashes, breaks his leg, and is buried under a rat horde. The group escapes onto Len's submarine via a Fortuna-luck glass ramp, Shroud having gotten Fortuna to safety. The very public fight pushes Dynamis and the Augusti toward open war, with Pluto watching them flee.

CH109 'Carnival Town': the submarine reaches Monaco on the way to Antarctica. By burner phone Ryan learns the aftermath - Livia is grounded, Dynamis and the Augusti near open war (Hector Manada may recall Alphonse), and Pluto killed Jamie and Ki-jung for defecting (Ryan will restore them by loop but hides it from Felix for now). He reunites with Simon, who has walled off the Carnival and is building a new French republic with Martine, long ago guessed Ryan's time-loop, agrees to foster the expedition's children, and knows Station Orpheon's history. Leo 'Sunshine' Hargraves joins the team as a fire-Genome ally for the ice. Ryan resolves his Perfect Run must dismantle Augustus's factory and organization in quick succession to minimize casualties; Livia teases an in-person secret.

CH110 'The Truth Beneath the Ice': the expedition reaches Antarctica. Flying recon with Leo Hargraves, Ryan detects the Alchemist's base is sealed inside an artificial Thin Place - a Monaco-like pocket dimension that traps prisoners in as well as intruders out. Sunshine apologizes to Len for the Carnival's attempt on Bloodstream (they'd predicted he would kill his children and cause disaster) and swears to try a cure now. At found Station Orpheon, Panda fanboys over Sunshine (who invites him to the Carnival). Ryan freezes time, tears the pocket dimension open with his hands, and holds it with Resonators (Stitch + Atom Cat guard the exit). Inside, under a black sky, they find the base breached from within, sinking, defenses dead, and a huge dead non-Mechron cyborg killed by claws bearing an M/omega sigil. Ryan's armor reveals the dome is only the tip of a kilometers-long buried spaceship.

CH111 'Past Fragment: Origins of the Species' (Eva Fabre flashback, the setting's origin): stargazing near Station Orpheon, Eva witnesses a purple Thin-Place rift tear open and a kilometers-long Hegemony starship - fleeing a battle with rebel robot-ships - crash into Antarctica, sealing her inside its artificial pocket dimension. Inside the corpse-choked wreck (a civil war of scaled aliens vs their own freed robots, both marked with an M/omega sigil), a blue-Flux ooze engulfs her and splits her into ~10 quantum-echo copies (Eva-One the original). Jacking into the ship's biological overmind, she learns the whole cosmology: the Hegemony harvested Flux (Red/Blue/Orange/Green/Yellow/Violet/White; Black shunned) from the Ultimate Ones' colored realms via towers, conquered its universe enslaving worlds (a past Earth included), then tried to enslave the Ultimate Ones' formless messengers - drawing the punishment (free-willed robots, Black Flux rot) that collapsed it. The last Lord of Science fled via a Reality-Drive into Earth's reality and crashed here. Eva resolves to keep the tech from all governments and uplift humanity into a 'master race' herself - the birth of the Alchemist.

CH112 'The Thing': the team enters the crashed Hegemony ship. Ryan confirms it is alien ('Reptilians') and notices his Black Flux now cracks the fabric of this Thin Place - hinting his Black power might even kill energy or Elixirs. In the dome they find holograms of the seven Colored Worlds (Black missing) and, crucially, recognize Augustus's body-metal in the Orange World's substance-cube: Augustus is 'an Orange,' his flesh made of Adamantine, the ur-metal of a realm without time/life/death - which explains why time-stop, Livia's skip, and Frank can touch the 'invincible' warlord while Julie Costa's life-touch never registered him. In the Elixir lab (the likely birthplace of Elixirs) they find seven vats and Wonderboxes; the Panda cracks the Alchemist's password by psych-profiling her; the Blue Elixir turns out to be a sapient, telepathic, possession-hungry being (muteness is the Alchemist's deliberate control feature). Then the captive Elixirs flood with fear as an alien with a green visor approaches from the dark corridor.

CH113 'Final Contact': a surviving Hegemony Soldier ('E.T.') ambushes the team, wielding every Flux color from a finite stolen reserve - teleport, phasing, a White cancel-shield, seed-cannon, and an Adamantine armor-shift. The group can't safely use powers near the Elixir vats, but Ryan cracks its adamantine visor with Black Flux, corrupting its seven-color balance and collapsing it into a black hole. Inside that hole Darkling speaks: the Hegemony fell decades ago, no invasion or rescue is coming - the ship is just vengeful ghosts of a lost war, and the killed alien was a mere grunt. Eva Fabre read that history as a blueprint and repeated its hubris, birthing Genomes and Psychos. The Violet Ultimate One never acts directly; it sent Ryan via visions so a human could end a human-made disaster. Ryan, now able to speak Elixir and nearest to ascension, resolves to find the ship's control-mind and destroy the ship across all timelines - though the Alchemist will fight to keep it.

CH114 'Chemical Reaction': pushing through the plant-choked, corpse-strewn ship toward its command center, Len finishes decoding the Alchemist's data and drops two bombshells - Elixir genetics (Genome children are always stable Genomes, so Homo Novus will supplant Homo Sapiens in ~200 years; Psychos are a deliberate multi-color synergy experiment, sterile by design) and, worst of all, the Alchemist has had a working Psycho cure FROM THE START and withheld it. Sarin's grief turns to fury. They reach a checkpoint where quantum-duplicate Eva Fabre clones (the Purple-World-vision Founders) fight off Hegemony Soldiers before the blue command-center gate. The Evas admit, without remorse, that the apocalypse was 'an acceptable loss' for Homo Novus and mankind their lab rats. Ryan diagnoses her flaw: her Elixir gave her an echo chamber of adoring copies that eroded her conscience. Sunshine arrests her for genocide; battle erupts, and Ryan freezes time and locks onto the command-center gate.

CH115 'The Clone War': the battle for the command gate rages - Eva's clones swarm endlessly with shields, suicide belts, and Green-Flux revert-rifles, while awakened Hegemony Soldiers (including a winged nine-eyed dragon) crash the fight. Mr. Wave's crew hold the line so Ryan and Len can slip through the blue gate into the command center. There they find the real Eva Fabre: a human head on a biomechanical body fused into the ship's overmind, remorseless and consequence-free. Ryan can't pilot the ship (a Violet, not a Blue), so he infects the overmind brain with Black Flux, tearing open black-hole rifts and summoning the Black Ultimate One, which devours Eva, her clones, and the aliens, and sends the captive Elixirs home. In the Black World, Darkling confirms the ship will vanish from Ryan's timeline on reload, warns that Black is self-reinforcing and could consume Ryan himself, and affirms Elixirs will walk with humanity to the stars. The team is expelled safely; Station Orpheon and the Alchemist are gone. Ryan now wants to live to see mankind reach the cosmos.

CH116 'Couple Therapy': in the refurbished, warm Station Orpheon lab, Ryan's Geniuses (Shortie/Len, Alchemo, Stitch) plus the Panda attempt the Psycho cure on Sarin using copied Alchemist data and a Chronoradio-based Flux signal - no guarantee, since they lack the alien tech. Ryan coaxes the wary Sarin into the vat with a heart-to-heart on vulnerability (recalling his own fear of Livia). The loudspeakered Elixir debate exposes the Psycho mechanism: two rival Elixirs (Red + Orange) each thought they had the sole host, unaware she was a 'twin' - incompetence, not malice. Instructed, they 'divorce,' each taking a DNA share; her gas cloud condenses into flesh. Sarin's true self, Bianca - a small ~30yo woman with green-orange hair, memories intact from the saved Meta-Gang-loop sample - is restored, weeping and embracing Ryan. Lore: True Genomes exist biologically + immaterially, and that immaterial consciousness can grow beyond the body and ASCEND. The Psycho scourge finally has a cure.

CH117 'Making Waves': on the submarine home, Bianca demos her cleanly-separated powers (Orange gas no longer corrosive, Red intact) and pledges loyalty; the team debates mass-producing the Psycho cure across Europe (Enrique Manada as a possible partner) and Stitch projects Elixirs will vanish from circulation in ~10 years, so future Genomes will be born, not made. Ryan comes clean to Mr. Wave, his hero and surrogate father, who already knew and is proud. Alchemo reports a breakthrough: since a Genome's consciousness is intangible Flux, he can refine the Chronoradio to send 5-6 mindmaps back per reload (brain matter no longer required) - reshaping the endgame into a coordinated team-reload strike (Livia, Len, Shroud, Bianca, plus a Dynamis insider) to hit the Meta-Gang instantly. Ryan then convinces a skeptical Felix he's a time-traveler via an unrepeatable private memory; Felix, learning his sister died for him and that he condemned the now-dead Jamie and Ki-jung, commits to the mission. Arriving at the coast, they find New Rome ablaze again - Augustus struck in Ryan's absence.

CH118 'The Last Quest' (final loop begins): at a Sorrentos meeting (Neptune/Silvio cleared the guards), Ryan's group reunites with Livia, Fortuna, and Narcinia. Fortuna claims Shroud as her husband-to-be. Livia confirms Augustus launched war on Dynamis in Ryan's absence (Fallout given command of the corporate army) and finally drops every excuse for her father - 'it's all him, he will never change' - committing fully to bringing her family down. Leo Hargraves reveals Narcinia is Giulia Costa, daughter of his murdered hero friends Bruno (Yellow) and Julie (Green) Costa, whom Augustus killed before Bacchus erased her memory; Leo owns his accidental killing of Livia's mother Juno and vows to face trial. Privately Livia tells Ryan 'I love you' for the first time and he answers in kind. Together they lock the full endgame: send 5-6 minds back (Livia, Len, Bianca, Felix, Shroud, the Panda), hit Adam's bunker within hours to save Rust Town captives, build the Saturn armor, cure the Psychos, break Dynamis (seizing the Gravity Gun), then the Olympians, then Augustus - with Ryan saving ~10s after the mind-transfer so memories survive a forced reload. The true Perfect Run begins.

CH119 'The Last Save': aboard the submarine, six travelers (Livia, Len, Bianca, Felix, Shroud, and the Panda/Timmy) don helmets on Alchemo's throne machine. The Panda gets a heartfelt send-off (Ryan tells him he was never useless); Sunshine warns Ryan the Black World power annihilated Mechron and nearly all Sarajevo through careless curiosity, so use it sparingly - Augustus's death isn't worth the world. Ryan activates his power; during transfer the Illuminati/Violet Ultimate One pyramid watches through the Violet Flux window. All reload to May 8th (17th loop) with memories intact, confirmed by texts. Then two crises hit: Ryan CAN'T SAVE (his Elixir blocks freezing past 10 seconds, as in Monaco), so memories aren't locked; and his retroactive Black power - strengthened over two loops - has already ERASED Geist from existence (invisible even to Livia's precognition), proving lethal Black Flux could permanently scar the timeline. Chronoradio echoes urge him on. Ryan opens the run anyway: rams Ghoul, delivers the mail, and takes a comedic joyride tormenting Ghoul.

CH120 'Speedrunners': Ryan runs the honed bunker assault with his memory-loaded team. He drives Livia and Fortuna to the Junkyard (Ghoul chained to the hood), air-drops Felix and the Panda/Timmy, and Shroud saves Fortuna from collapsing debris; the guards (Reptilian, Gemini, Acid Rain, Mosquito, Mongrel) are subdued non-lethally. Inside, Bianca (secret code confirmed) turns on her old Meta-Gang, and the recreational Psychos fall - Ink Machine, Rakshasa, Incognito, Catcher (aka 'Fuckface'), and Penanggalan (aka 'Pale Guy'). Ryan Bliss-overdoses Psyshock and cons Frank the Mad into guarding the infirmary via a fake 'Agent Frank/Pearl Harbor' script Livia authored. His Plymouth Fury takes no damage for the first time ever - a 'holy sign.' He reaches the deep chamber and confronts Adam the Ogre, who reveals he is a fellow VIOLET; the priority-kill duel begins.

CH121 'Presidential Debate': Ryan duels Adam the Ogre alone in the vat chamber. Adam takes a Rust Town hostage boy; Ryan shoots him free and blinds Adam with depleted-uranium rounds. The fight exposes Adam's two powers: a Violet time-sense (he feels Ryan's freezes and shields his vitals, limiting Ryan to ~8-10 usable seconds) and a pocket dimension in his gullet (bleeds no blood; produces grenades, a flail, a crossbow, and a Blue Elixir syringe). Bolted in waist and leg, Ryan feeds Adam his own triggered A-bomb ('Filibuster!'); the pocket dimension contains most of the blast but flames cook Adam through the uranium bullet-holes, killing him. The Panda (whose prior-loop fight had revealed Adam's internal weakness) patches Ryan up as Livia holds his hand. The raid is a total success: zero casualties, every hostage saved, captive Psychos moved to underwater habitats. Psyshock is handed to Cancel; the bunker will be occupied and destroyed. Next: Dynamis, then the Augusti - after they celebrate.

CH122 'Second Chances': With the Meta-Gang crushed and Alchemo securing Adam's bunker, Ryan/Len/Felix bring the evidence dossier to Enrique Manada (Blackthorn) at Dynamis, Wyvern present. Enrique phone-checks and confirms every charge - Knockoffs made from Bloodstream slime, Len cloned at Lab Sixty-Six, Hector's collusion with Adam - and learns the doomsday risk: Len's blood would revert every Knockoff-drinker into a Bloodstream clone, killing millions. He unmasks, apologizes, and agrees to help dismantle the program and share the Gravity Gun data; Wyvern resigns in disgust and pleads with him to reform. Ryan nudges Wyvern to reconcile with Jasmine (Vulcan). Then Felix visits estranged friends Jamie, Ki-jung, and Lanka, winning their conditional neutrality: Ki-jung and Jamie will step aside once Augustus falls, Lanka stays silent. Next targets: Dynamis's Lab Sixty-Six / Alphonse, then the Augusti.

CH123 'The Last Break': Enrique delivers the Gravity Gun schematics; Ryan plans to miniaturize it into his armor to fling Augustus out of the atmosphere ('Kars Augustus') and insists on fighting him ALONE. At Livia's rented Dostoevski gathering the war-party assembles - the cured ex-Psychos Bianca, Helen (ex-Acid Rain), Jerome (ex-Mongrel), and Vlad/Vladimir (ex-Frank), plus Alchemo, the Doll, Toasty, Mathias, Fortuna, Felix, the Panda, and Len. Ryan confesses the full Black-power secret to Livia (he wished to die); she takes it calmly and asks only that he spare - imprison, not kill - her father, sharing her New European Republic endgame (merge a reformed Augusti with Dynamis). She gifts him the Opis armor (spider-themed, precog-piloted) and they exile the incurable Ghoul to Earth orbit aboard the SpaceZ rocket. Next in the gauntlet: Lab Sixty-Six, the Bliss Factory, then Augustus.

CH124 'Lab Closure': the three-pronged strike on Dynamis. Enrique and Len raid Lab Sixty-Six - Dr. Tyrano is subdued, explosives set, and Len tries the cure on her father Bloodstream; it fails (he has mutated past saving), so she euthanizes him via Tyrano's failsafe and grieves. Simultaneously Wyvern, Felix, and Il Migliore arrest Hector Manada at his mansion on Enrique's own mandate; he surrenders warning of Alphonse's revenge. Ryan (Saturn armor, now maxed with five all-color Flux batteries + a hidden chest Gravity Gun) and Livia (Opis armor) waltz over New Rome releasing the green Cure Flu, a benign virus that scrubs the Knockoff Elixirs from all of Europe's blood. Then Fallout 'rides the atom' from Sicily to attack, and Ryan and Livia stand together to face him.

CH125 'Fusion & Fission': Ryan and Livia battle Fallout over the Gulf of Naples - her timeskip makes Ryan intangible/invincible, cracking his suit and dropping him into the sea, where he sheds his cyborg armor into a radioactive skeleton and self-detonates like a nuke, gravely wounding Livia (who stayed in the blast to be sure Ryan survived). Ryan Black-Fluxes off both Fallout's arms rather than kill him. Enrique arrives, excavates Livia with his roots, and begs his brother to reconcile, daring Alphonse to kill him instead; Fallout refuses ('All for the dream') and moves to self-destruct again - so Shroud fires the full Dynamis Gravity Gun and launches Fallout into space, killing him with the weapon he funded. Livia survives concussed. New Rome is cured of one poison; only Augustus remains, on Ischia.

CH126 'The End is Nigh': aftermath and the eve of the final battle. Dynamis falls publicly, Enrique becomes acting Chairman and promises a public trial; no locals died in Fallout's blast, so the Perfect Run holds. Livia (recovering, saved by Braindead) shares intel - Vulcan has defected, Augustus ordered Wyvern's death, and his forces will invade Rust Town and find the bunker. After tender farewells with Livia and Len (who finds closure and will join The Architect to build cities worldwide), Ryan repairs his Saturn armor, installs Elixir-comms to name his Violet Elixir 'Magenta' (which explains the Ultimate One blocks his saves because his Black has grown dangerous, hints at Ascension, and confirms his Black can beat Augustus's conceptual-only metal), and takes the Plushie as an ally. He triggers the bunker self-destruct ('order Sixty-Six'), collapsing the Junkyard and destroying the Bahamut satellite - erasing Mechron's legacy - then flies to Ischia for the last battle.
